title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: We protect your privacy and secure your data
summary_point2_desc: Your data is not sent to our servers
summary_point3_desc: Everything works only on your device
data_collection_p1: At Hasenha, we strongly believe in your privacy. Therefore:
data_point1_desc: Passwords you generate never leave your device. We don't store them on our servers or in databases.
data_point2_desc: We don't use tracking tools or analytics that collect your personal data.
data_point3_desc: All password generation processes occur locally on your device without internet connection.
local_storage_p1: We use local storage in your browser to store:
local_storage_note: You can clear this data anytime through browser settings. Locally stored data is not shared with us or third parties.
cookies_p1: We do not use cookies for tracking or data collection. We may use local storage techniques similar to cookies to remember:
third_parties_p1: We do not share your data with any third parties. External services we use:
service_google_fonts_desc: For loading fonts only - doesn't include tracking
service_aos_desc: To enhance user experience with animations
security_p1: We apply the highest security standards to protect your privacy:
security_feature1_desc: All processes occur on your device without sending data to servers
security_feature2_desc: Everyone can review the code and ensure security
security_feature3_desc: Secure and encrypted connection to the website
security_feature4_desc: We continuously improve security and fix vulnerabilities
your_rights_p1: You have the full right to:
right1_desc: Know how your data is used
right3_desc: Export your data in readable format
contact_p1: For any privacy inquiries, you can contact us:
response_time: We respond to all privacy inquiries within 48 hours
